headline: McLeod Russel pledges promoter shares to NARCL
summary: McLeod Russel India Limited disclosed the execution of a pledge agreement on promoter shares with NARCL on October 9, 2026, as part of a master restructuring deal.

headline: Fedbank Financial to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd will hold an analyst and investor call on October 15, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST to discuss its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Aurionpro sets Q2FY27 earnings call for Nov 2
summary: Aurionpro Solutions will host its Q2FY27 earnings conference call on November 2, 2026, at 9:30 am IST. Management, including CEO Ashish Rai and CFO Vipul Parmar, will discuss un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: SIS Ltd buys back 50,000 shares at ₹416.83
summary: SIS Limited acquired 50,000 equity shares on October 9, 2026, at an average price of ₹416.83. The cumulative buyback now stands at 23.35 lakh shares.

headline: Tanfac Industries shares get BSE trading approval
summary: BSE approved trading of 4,24,647 equity shares issued by Tanfac Industries on a preferential basis at ₹2,341 per share. Listing effective October 12, 2026.

headline: Shayona Engineering appoints Finportal as IR agency
summary: Shayona Engineering Limited has appointed Finportal Investments Private Limited as its Investor Relations agency effective October 1, 2025. The company also designated a specific email for investor queries.

headline: Aequs promoter releases pledge on 1.00 crore shares
summary: Melligeri Private Family Foundation released pledge on 1,00,51,307 Aequs shares on Oct 8, 2026. The release was temporary to meet regulatory requirements.

headline: Laxmi Dental to host investor meet on Oct 15
summary: Laxmi Dental Limited will hold a group meeting with analysts and institutional investors at its Mumbai facilities on October 15, 2026. Discussions will focus on publicly available information.

headline: Safa Systems promoter group stake rises to 49.21%
summary: Safa Systems & Technologies promoter group increased its holding to 49.21% via a preferential issue of 23.90 lakh shares on October 5, 2026.

headline: Mandora Finserve exits ECS Biztech stake
summary: Mandora Finserve Private Limited sold its entire 5.56% equity stake in ECS Biztech Limited to Komal Infotech Private Limited via off-market deal.

headline: Capri Global Capital to raise funds via equity or debt
summary: Capri Global Capital board meets Oct 14, 2026, to consider raising funds through equity, debt, or convertible securities. Trading window closed since Oct 1.

headline: Akme Fintrade board approves ₹50 crore NCD issuance
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Ltd board approved issuance of secured NCDs up to ₹50 crore on private placement. The board also authorized a larger ₹300 crore limit for future tranches.

headline: Tata Motors unit raises Iveco tender offer to €14.40
summary: Tata Motors' indirect subsidiary has raised its voluntary tender offer for Iveco Group N.V. to €14.40 per share from €14.10 per share, inclusive of dividends.

headline: Adani Green Energy to review Q2 results on October 21
summary: Adani Green Energy has scheduled a board meeting on October 21 to review its Q2 financial results.

headline: Avantel secures contract valued at ₹12 crore
summary: Avantel has secured a new contract valued at ₹12 crore, marking a notable business development for the company.

headline: Shilpa Medicare gets Europe GMP nod for Unit 4
summary: Shilpa Medicare's Jadcherla Unit 4 received GMP certification from AGES Austria following a successful inspection in July 2026, enabling sterile and non-sterile exports to Europe.

headline: Amwill Health secures CDSCO import license
summary: Amwill Health Care Ltd obtained a CDSCO import registration certificate for FoliColor Oxidative hair colour, enabling commercial sales in India.

headline: ISOCL volume up 31.7% YoY in Sep 2026
summary: Inter State Oil Carrier handled 27,880 MT in September 2026, a 31.7% YoY rise. MoM volume dipped 1.6% from August levels.

headline: Chemplast Sanmar to acquire 27% in solar firm
summary: Chemplast Sanmar will acquire 27% equity in Yesaryes Energy for ₹45 lakh to source green energy via a 37.5 MW solar plant, aiming to reduce captive power costs.

headline: Dixon meets PL Capital, Balyasny
summary: Dixon Technologies held investor meetings with PL Capital and Balyasny Asset Management on October 9, 2026. No price-sensitive info was shared.

headline: Garware Hi-Tech Films reports insider trading violation
summary: A designated person violated the Code of Conduct by executing a contra trade. The Audit Committee imposed a ₹5,000 penalty for the inadvertent breach.

headline: Bhumi Gadia exits Atharv Enterprises stake
summary: Bhumi Gadia sold 7.53 lakh shares (4.43%) of Atharv Enterprises via open market, reducing holding to zero between Aug and Sep 2026.

headline: Bhagwati Autocast appoints Rahul Pitaliya as CS
summary: Bhagwati Autocast Limited appointed Rahul Pitaliya as Whole Time Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 10, 2026, per SEBI regulations.

headline: Meesho Day 1 orders jump 75% YoY in Mega Blockbuster Sale
summary: Meesho Ltd reported ~75% YoY growth in Day 1 orders for its Mega Blockbuster Sale. Peak demand hit 75,000 orders/minute, with transacting customers up 60% YoY.

headline: Adani Green energy sales up 32% in H1 FY27
summary: Adani Green Energy Ltd reported a 32% YoY rise in energy sales to 25,747 mn units in H1 FY27. Operational capacity grew 24% to 20,763 MW with significant greenfield additions.

headline: Premier Polyfilm Q2FY27 Net Profit Rises 22% YoY
summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a 22% YoY rise in net profit to ₹981 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by strong revenue growth and improved operating margins.

headline: Dolat Algotech CFO certifies CP usage for Q3FY26
summary: Dolat Algotech Ltd CFO Vaibhav P. Shah certified that commercial paper proceeds were used for working capital and MTM obligations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Baba Arts sets Oct 27 cut-off for 27th AGM voting
summary: Baba Arts Limited fixed October 27, 2026 as the cut-off date for determining members eligible to vote at its 27th Annual General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled for November 3, 2026.

headline: Asi Industries acquires 0.033% stake in Lloyds Enterprises
summary: Asi Industries Limited acquired an additional 0.027% equity stake in Lloyds Enterprises Limited for ₹3.03 crore, bringing its total holding to 0.033%. The move is purely for investment purposes.

headline: Bhandari Hosiery CS resigns
summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Ltd announced the resignation of Shilpa Tiwari as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer due to personal reasons, effective October 17, 2026.

headline: Quest Flow Controls board approves director changes
summary: Quest Flow Controls Limited approved the resignation of Lalit Varshney and appointment of Jitendra Bhosale as Non-Executive Directors. The board also raised the Executive Director's remuneration to ₹1.2 crore.

headline: Nanta Tech passes key EGM resolutions
summary: Nanta Tech shareholders approved increase in authorized capital and preferential issue of convertible warrants at the October 10, 2026 EGM.

headline: Baba Arts FY26 results: Revenue jumps 167%, profit falls
summary: Baba Arts Ltd reported a 167% surge in revenue to ₹1,494.75 lakh in FY26, but net profit declined to ₹65.30 lakh due to lower margins in IP trading.

headline: ADF Foods subsidiary settles US litigation for $1.75M
summary: ADF Foods (USA) Ltd. executed a Forbearance Agreement with Ascot Valley Foods to settle judgments of $2.31 million. The settlement totals $1.75 million, with an initial $450,000 payment received.

headline: Jhandewalas Foods CS resigns effective June 2026
summary: Jhandewalas Foods Limited announced the resignation of Shipra Gandhi as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, citing personal reasons, effective June 16, 2026.

stock_name: German Green Steel and Power L
headline: German Green Steel delegates materiality decisions to KMPs
summary: German Green Steel and Power Limited has authorized its Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of events for stock exchange disclosures under SEBI regulations.

stock_name: German Green Steel and Power L
headline: German Green Steel appoints Abira Mansuri as CS
summary: German Green Steel and Power Limited appointed Abira Mansuri as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective August 1, 2026, in line with SEBI regulations.

stock_name: German Green Steel and Power L
headline: German Green Steel appoints Bigshare as RTA
summary: German Green Steel and Power Limited has appointed Bigshare Services Private Limited as its Registrar & Share Transfer Agent in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Marc Loire Fashions seeks to double authorised capital
summary: Marc Loire Fashions Limited held an EGM on October 10, 2026, to approve increasing its authorised share capital from ₹8 crore to ₹20 crore. The move aims to provide flexibility for future capital requirements.

headline: Ajel Ltd auditor GMK & Co resigns citing pre-occupation
summary: Ajel Limited confirmed the resignation of statutory auditors M/s. GMK & Co due to pre-occupation. The board noted no adverse concerns or disagreements with the audit firm.

headline: Quality Power corrects VWAP, share count in EGM notice
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice, correcting the 90-day VWAP to ₹1,238.49 and adjusting the maximum equity share count to 10,17,123.

headline: Oswal Pumps redirects IPO funds to solar cell plant
summary: Oswal Pumps approves a ₹4,558.50 million greenfield 1.2 GW solar cell plant in Karnal, redirecting ₹1,598.50 million from IPO proceeds to secure supply chain control.

headline: Fabtech Cleanrooms secures ₹35.60 cr orders in Sep 2026
summary: Fabtech Cleanrooms Limited reported new orders worth ₹35.60 crore for September 2026, bringing its total order book to ₹468.18 crore.

headline: Rathi Steel receives ₹59.44 lakh GST demand
summary: Rathi Steel & Power received a GST demand of ₹59.44 lakh from Rourkela authorities for January 2021 interest. The company states no material impact and plans to contest the order.

headline: RBI approves Anshul Laxkar as ED at Jineshvar Securities
summary: RBI approved the change in designation of Anshul Laxkar to Executive Director at Jineshvar Securities, a material subsidiary of Arix Energix (formerly Jupiter Infomedia).
